narration: Rain changes a street, but it does not stop the day. Some people shelter under a roof while others keep moving. Look at the broad hats and the covers over a carried load. These are responses to weather, as much as elements of dress. If you expect a line of modern umbrellas, the shapes may surprise you. A visitor might first notice an unusual hat. Look again, and there are people working, resting, and getting somewhere. The scene lets clothing become a practical part of ordinary life. This painting is attributed to Uncho. From the TJ Kim Collection, a rainy street brings distant lives a little closer.
